Dual-backend disagreements

Source: R/classify_dual.R
dual_disagreements.Rd

Returns the rows of the `dual` attribute where the two backends did not agree - the variables a human must decide on. Each row carries both layer chains and whether the LLM side produced a candidate IR the reviewer can inspect as a starting point.

Usage

dual_disagreements(ir)

Arguments

ir

IR list returned by [classify_variables_dual()].

Value

A data.frame with columns `variable`, `class`, `rules_layers`, `llm_layers`, `llm_suggestion`; zero rows when every variable agreed.

Details

Extract the dual-backend review queue
